name: healthsync-performance-tests
description: Enterprise k6 performance testing suite for HealthSync

scripts.smoke-test: k6 run smoke-test.js  --env BASE_URL=%BASE_URL% --env TEST_MODE=true  --out json=reports/smoke-results.json
scripts.load-test: k6 run load-test.js   --env BASE_URL=%BASE_URL% --env TEST_MODE=true  --out json=reports/load-results.json   --out csv=reports/load-results.csv
scripts.stress-test: k6 run stress-test.js --env BASE_URL=%BASE_URL% --env TEST_MODE=true  --out json=reports/stress-results.json --out csv=reports/stress-results.csv
scripts.spike-test: k6 run spike-test.js  --env BASE_URL=%BASE_URL% --env TEST_MODE=true  --out json=reports/spike-results.json  --out csv=reports/spike-results.csv
scripts.soak-test: k6 run soak-test.js   --env BASE_URL=%BASE_URL% --env TEST_MODE=true  --out json=reports/soak-results.json   --out csv=reports/soak-results.csv
scripts.perf-all: npm run smoke-test && npm run load-test && npm run stress-test && npm run spike-test
